recommendations.recommendation: Seek rest for your restless heart in God, for whom you were made.
recommendations.rationale: God made humans for himself, so the heart stays restless until it rests in him.

recommendations.recommendation: Confess your sins to God honestly and join confession with praise.
recommendations.rationale: God already knows all, but confession heals the soul and stirs others who hear it to praise God and pray.
recommendations.scope: Augustine as example for his readers

recommendations.recommendation: Acknowledge that human sinfulness is present even from infancy.
recommendations.rationale: Infants show jealousy and greed; their innocence lies in weak limbs, not in their will.
recommendations.argued_against: the belief that children are wholly innocent

recommendations.recommendation: Love friends and created things in God rather than for their own sake.
recommendations.rationale: Loving a mortal friend as if he would never die brought crushing grief at his death; only God, who never passes away, cannot be lost.
recommendations.argued_against: pouring the soul out on perishable things

recommendations.recommendation: Do not postpone turning to God and abandoning sinful habits.
recommendations.rationale: His long delays, asking for chastity but not yet, kept him chained by habit and a divided will until the garden conversion.

recommendations.recommendation: Rely on God's grace, not your own strength, for chastity and virtue.
recommendations.rationale: No one can be continent unless God grants it, so one should ask God to give what he commands.
recommendations.argued_against: trust in one's own power to be good

recommendations.recommendation: Read Scripture with humility.
recommendations.rationale: Pride made its plain style seem unworthy next to Cicero, but Scripture grows with the humble, and Ambrose's spiritual reading opened its meaning.
recommendations.argued_against: the proud reader who prefers eloquence

recommendations.recommendation: Embrace humility and the way of Christ rather than relying on philosophical insight alone.
recommendations.rationale: The Platonists glimpsed the homeland but not the way to it; only the humble, incarnate Christ leads there.

recommendations.recommendation: Believe that evil is not a substance but a lack of good arising from a will turned away from God.
recommendations.rationale: Everything that exists was created good by God, so evil cannot be a thing of its own.

recommendations.recommendation: Reject astrology and fortune-telling.
recommendations.rationale: Astrology shifts blame for sin onto the stars, and people born at the same moment meet different fates, so correct predictions come by chance.
recommendations.argued_against: astrologers and those who consult them

recommendations.recommendation: Guard against curiosity and the lust of the eyes, such as the craving for spectacles.
recommendations.rationale: Alypius was swept into frenzy at the gladiator games, and idle curiosity pulls the soul away from God.
recommendations.argued_against: theater, gladiatorial shows, and idle curiosity

recommendations.recommendation: Do not set your heart on worldly ambition, honors, and wealth.
recommendations.rationale: Preparing lying praise of the emperor, he envied a cheerful drunken beggar; ambition brought only anxiety.
recommendations.argued_against: careers built on vanity and flattery

recommendations.recommendation: Do not join in wrongdoing for the sake of companionship.
recommendations.rationale: He would never have stolen the pears alone; the thrill came from shared mischief, a friendship that was really unfriendly.

recommendations.recommendation: Take food and drink as medicine, with moderation, and watch for pleasure creeping in.
recommendations.rationale: Pleasure disguises itself as necessity, so the appetite must be restrained every day.

recommendations.recommendation: Use singing in church cautiously so that the words, not the melody, move you.
recommendations.rationale: Singing can stir weaker minds to devotion, but being moved more by music than by meaning is a fault.
recommendations.conditions: only while the words remain primary
recommendations.argued_against: taking pleasure in sound over sense

recommendations.recommendation: Do not seek human praise or let it feed your pride.
recommendations.rationale: Love of praise is a persistent temptation that corrupts even good deeds and is hard to detect.

recommendations.recommendation: Search for God by turning inward through memory rather than outward to external beauty.
recommendations.rationale: He sought God outside while God was within; he loved God late because he rushed after created beauties.

recommendations.recommendation: Grieve for the dead with restraint and hope, offering tears to God.
recommendations.rationale: A faithful death is not wretched, so he held back tears at Monica's burial and later wept privately before God.

recommendations.recommendation: Remember Monica and Patricius at the altar and pray for the dead.
recommendations.rationale: Monica asked only to be remembered at the Lord's altar, and Augustine passes the request to his readers.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Persevere in praying for a loved one's conversion.
recommendations.rationale: Monica's years of tears and prayers were answered in his conversion, as a bishop had assured her.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not ask what God did before creation; time itself began with creation.
recommendations.rationale: God is eternal and time is his creature, so there was no time before creation.
recommendations.argued_against: those who mock creation by asking what God was doing before

recommendations.recommendation: Accept that Scripture may hold several true meanings and interpret it with charity rather than contention.
recommendations.rationale: Many readings can be true, and quarreling over them violates the love the commandments require.

recommendations.recommendation: Do not raise children for worldly eloquence and success at the expense of moral formation.
recommendations.rationale: His teachers punished grammatical slips more than sins, and his parents cared for his career more than his chastity.
recommendations.argued_against: schooling aimed at vanity, and ambitious parents
